subject: Sundance Labs - Remittance activation & PO routing
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sundance Labs Accounts Payable <ap@sundancelabs.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 09:24:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor bank details + remit routing for upcoming PO

Hi AP team,

We have an approved PO coming for Sundance Labs (PO 3109) and need to get your banking and remittance details set up so Finance can route payment on receipt of invoice. Can you please: 
- Confirm the preferred remit email/address for your invoices
- Complete and return the attached bank details form (bank_details_form.pdf)
- Confirm whether you prefer PO# in the remittance reference or an invoice-only reference

For our side: invoice will be processed Net30 unless otherwise agreed. I have looped in Aditya from Sales and Lauren from Procurement to help coordinate.

Attachments: bank_details_form.pdf (blank)

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (510) 555-0192
From: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@sundancelabs.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Jan 2027 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor bank details + remit routing for upcoming PO

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the note. Please find our completed bank details attached (bank_details_form.pdf). A couple of quick clarifications:
- Our bank account name is registered to Sundance Labs, LLC; the routing number on the form is for our operating bank but our payment clearing is handled by First National Clearing. If Finance requires a micro-deposit for verification we can accept that.
- Remittances: we prefer the PO# in the remittance reference field. The remit email we use for automated reconciliation is remit@sundancelabs.com.

Attachments: bank_details_form.pdf (filled), sample-voided-check.png

Best,
Lisa Chen
Accounts Payable
Sundance Labs
lisa.chen@sundancelabs.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@sundancelabs.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Jan 2027 08:32:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor bank details + remit routing for upcoming PO

Hi Lisa,

Appreciate the quick turnaround and for confirming remit@sundancelabs.com. I attached a signed W9 for Sundance (sundance_w9_signed.pdf) and the completed bank form saved from your submission.

Next steps from Procurement/Finance here:
- I will upload the bank form + W9 to the vendor record and send to AP for verification.
- Finance will attempt a micro-deposit for account confirmation unless you can provide a prior successful ACH confirmation token.
- Please confirm the exact string you want us to send in the remittance reference (e.g., PO 3109 or SUNDANCE-3109). That will be the guaranteed field we include on our payments.

Also tagging Aditya on the PO/payment terms for commercial confirmation.

Attachments: sundance_w9_signed.pdf, bank_details_form.pdf (from Lisa)

Thanks,
Marissa
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@sundancelabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2027 14:10:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Vendor bank details + remit routing for upcoming PO

Hi Lisa,

Quick commercial confirmation from our side: PO 3109 has been approved under DEAL-2027-0118-SND and the agreed payment term is Net30. Can you confirm that you will invoice to invoice@sundancelabs.com and that remit@sundancelabs.com will be used by your AR team for reconciliation? Once confirmed we will proceed with issuing the PO and Finance will schedule the micro-deposit.

One additional ask: please include the PO number in the invoice PDF filename if possible (e.g., invoice_PO3109.pdf) — that helps our AP automation.

Thanks and looking forward to a smooth first payment,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com
From: Sundance Labs Accounts Payable <ap@sundancelabs.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor bank details + remit routing for upcoming PO

Hi Marissa and Aditya,

Thanks — confirmed. AP will accept invoices at invoice@sundancelabs.com and remit@sundancelabs.com will be the reconciliation address. We prefer the remittance reference to be exactly: PO 3109. Please include that string on any payment instructions.

Finance note: we do not currently have an ACH token to share; please proceed with your micro-deposit verification. Expect 1-2 small test deposits to clear in 2-3 business days. Once you see the micro-deposit amounts, reply to this thread with the values and we will confirm activation.

Attached is a short remittance guidance doc with preferred file naming and data fields (remit_instructions.docx). Also, a DocuSign packet for payment terms was sent to Aditya earlier: https://app.docusign.com/packet/XYZ-12345

Attachments: remit_instructions.docx

Regards,
Sundance Labs Accounts Payable
ap@sundancelabs.com
